about: The safety floor of hesitation removal: sounds that are a word in no language, removed in code from every dictation, with or without AI, in any language. Nothing language-dependent belongs here: 'um' is German and Portuguese, 'er' German, 'eh' and 'ah' interjections, 'like', 'also' and 'este' real words. Those are left to the speech model and the language model. Add a sound only when it is a word in no language, with a source and a benchmark case in HushTests/Fixtures/Cleanup/filler-words.json.
